scripts.init-back: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run back" "npm run front" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.clean:pycache: python -c "import pathlib, shutil; [shutil.rmtree(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('__pycache__')]"
scripts.electron:build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && electron-builder
